response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A8.1"], "rationale": "The claim is for essential purchases due to a significant delay in luggage arrival (35 hours), which falls under the coverage for delayed luggage as defined in clause A8.1. The evidence shows the luggage was delayed and the insured had to buy hygiene items and clothing, which are covered under this clause. Clause A8.3 does not apply because the delay exceeded 12 hours, and clause A8.2 is not relevant here as the claim is about essential purchases, not the luggage damage itself."}
